dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: Piramida is where we Lightkeepers are headquartered. Legend holds that it was founded by our first Starshyna, Solovei the Torchforger.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: And before that, this was once the palace of the fae governor of Nod-Krai. In fact, you can still see the coat of arms from that era on the stone walls of the foundations.

dialogues.speaker: Nikita
dialogues.text: If the stories are true, who knows, you might even uncover the fae governor's buried treasure.
